quests.title: Reminiscence of Seirai

dialogue.t: Hmm, this is quite the headache...

dialogue.sit: Would you know anything about this map...

dialogue.t: Judging by the topography, I'd say that this is some place on Seirai Island...
The Guild has commissioned several expeditions to Seirai Island in the past.
The adventurers who accepted those commissions would bring us intel on the island in the form of reports.
Unfortunately, manpower issues have prevented us from launching large-scale expeditions, so we're stuck sending a few adventurers at a time to explore the area.
I'm afraid that this limits the extent to which I can continue helping you to analyze this map.
However, I do know someone who might have more to do with Seirai Island than me.
His name's Oda Tarou. I've heard that his ancestors used to live on Seirai Island before migrating here for various reasons.
Speaking of which, he did come to the Guild some time back to hire some adventurers who would accompany him to Seirai Island to see the place...
You can ask him about this map. With any luck, he might know something about it.
*sigh* When will I find someone who'll accompany me back there...

dialogue.sit: Would you know anything about this map...

dialogue.t: Are you... an adventurer with the Guild? Can they finally spare the people?

dialogue.sit: Uh, I'm just a passing traveler.

dialogue.t: Hmm, fine, then... What's this map you spoke of?
Now, let me see...
Th—This! Could it be...
Isn't this Seirai Island!?
Haha, is it really? I just guessed.
Although my ancestors once lived on Seirai Island, that was a very long time ago now.
By the time we came to my generation, we no longer had any impression of our old home.
All we have left in the house to remind us of it are three landscape paintings of the island.

dialogue.sit: So why do you want to go back?

dialogue.t: Well... It is still my "hometown," is it not?
I feel like... I have to go see it no matter what.
Unfortunately, I'm pretty busy running my business at the moment, so I haven't the time to go.
Additionally, I had some trouble finding adventurers willing to escort me to Seirai Island...
So I went with Option B: putting up a commission at the Adventurers' Guild.
Hopefully, some adventurers can help me go to Seirai Island, find the three places shown in those paintings, take a few pictures with a Kamera, and bring those pictures back to me.
But no one's picked up that commission thus far...

dialogue.sit: I can go there for you.

dialogue.t: W—Would you really? That would be amazing!
As for payment, you need not worry. I will have it ready for you for sure.
Well then, Traveler, I'll be counting on you. Including the map you brought, that would make four locations to take pictures of...
Well then, Traveler, please head to these four locations and snap a picture of each of them for me.
Seirai Island... How I wish I could see you for myself.
But where will I find the time...
You're back. How's it going? Did you manage to get those pictures?
Wonderful. Please, let me see them...
Um... Well...
Ahaha! I can't tell where these places are at all...
It does seem that those three locations have changed a lot since our family left.
I wonder if Miss Fujiwara Toshiko will be able to recognize them.
Well, actually... I doubt it.
More accurately, she's in the same boat as me — our ancestors both lived there.
Actually, there's a lot of us here in Inazuma City whose ancestors were once natives of the island, you know?

dialogue.sit: So why did you all move away?

dialogue.t: I don't really remember anymore... It was a very long time ago.
I think it might have been the crazy storms, or to prevent smuggling and illegal border crossings...
Whatever the case, the Shogunate arranged for the inhabitants of the island to come to Narukami Island.
Well, that's neither here nor there. This is for you. Take it as thanks for running this errand for me.
*sigh* Ah, I do wish that I could go to Seirai Island in person sometime...
But I've got all this business to take care of...

quests.description: You uncover a strange picture on Seirai Island…
